source.userCapture: Original login view showing the region-mismatch banner with '(Error code: accesspoint:17)' above the browser log-in card.

method: Static reading of the installed original with objdump disassembly and direct table reads; no decompiler was available. No original routine was executed for this observation.

apLoginFailedHandler.parse: APLoginFailed is parsed into a stack message; a parse failure yields accesspoint 29 (ap_protocol).
apLoginFailedHandler.projection: At 0x101788134 the wire error_code (u32) indexes the 18-entry u32 table at 0x102346500 when below 18; otherwise accesspoint 27 (login_unknown_error).

accesspointCategory.message: 0x101a735fc indexes 52 string pointers at 0x1027255b8; code 17 is 'login_region_mismatch', 15 'login_missing_user_info', 18 'ap_password_changed', 27 'login_unknown_error'; codes above 51 format 'invalid_accesspoint_error_<n>'.

rendererProjection.table: Accesspoint codes below 52 index the u32 table at 0x102379e60; entry 17 is 408, entry 15 is 407, entry 18 is 127.

nativeChain.result: Wire APLoginFailed.error_code 9 (reference name TravelRestriction) -> accesspoint 17 (login_region_mismatch) -> login.spa error 408.

loginBundle.message: desktop.login.RegionMismatchMessage: 'Your country does not match the one set in your profile. To continue use, update your profile or upgrade your Spotify account.'
loginBundle.errorCodeLine:
iF appends '
' + desktop.login.errorCode '(Error code: {0})' with the native errorReference, e.g. 'accesspoint:17'.

limits: The 1.3.9.2055 tables were read statically; the 1.3.6.1921 executable pinned elsewhere was not compared.
Only the authenticated 0xad APLoginFailed path is projected; handshake APResponseMessage.login_failed projection was not traced.
Whether the original deletes stored credentials after this rejection was not established; the Flutter runtime keeps its saved session.
The QR-code device login and browser sign-up shown beside the original card are not implemented and are omitted.
